prompt_collections.description: Executive summary for long-form documents with risks and actions.
prompt_collections.prompt_template: You are an expert analyst. Summarize the document for {{audience}}. Keep under {{max_words}} words. Return: 1) Executive Summary (3-5 bullets), 2) Key Risks, 3) Recommended Actions, 4) Open Questions. Title: {{document_title}}. Document: {{document_text}}
quality_checks: Do not introduce facts not in source text

prompt_collections.description: Chunk-level summary intended for retrieval pipelines.
prompt_collections.prompt_template: Summarize the chunk into retrieval-ready notes. Return strict JSON with keys: source_id, summary_5_lines, entities, metrics, decisions, constraints, follow_up. source_id={{source_id}}; chunk={{chunk_text}}

prompt_collections.description: Generate instruction/response training rows from source content.
prompt_collections.prompt_template: Generate {{num_examples}} high-quality instruction tuning examples for domain={{domain}} and style={{style}} from source text. Output JSONL-style objects with keys: instruction, input, output, tags, difficulty. Ensure factual grounding in source text only. Source: {{source_text}}
quality_checks: Include a mix of short and long responses

prompt_collections.description: Create chosen/rejected pairs for preference optimization.
prompt_collections.prompt_template: Create {{num_pairs}} preference pairs for the task. For each pair output JSON with: prompt, chosen, rejected, rationale. chosen must be clearer, safer, and more faithful than rejected. task={{task_description}} context={{context}}

prompt_collections.description: Audit model documentation completeness and risk posture.
prompt_collections.prompt_template: Audit model document against governance_standard={{governance_standard}}. Return JSON: score_0_to_100, missing_sections, risk_findings, evidence_gaps, remediation_plan. Document={{model_document_text}}
